what: Infosys is an Indian information technology services company. It runs, maintains and modernises the software systems of large corporations worldwide, and increasingly builds artificial intelligence into those systems.
customers: Banks, insurers, retailers, manufacturers and communications companies, mostly in North America and Europe.
money: technology services to banks and insurers
moat: A trained workforce of hundreds of thousands at Indian cost levels, with multi-year contracts that embed it in customers' core systems.
risks: Client technology budgets have been tight for two years
Artificial intelligence may reduce the number of people needed per project, which is how this industry bills
US immigration policy affects its staffing model
Revenue grew only about 5% last year
opportunities: Almost no debt: about $516 million against $4 billion of cash
A dividend yield around 4.5% with large buybacks
Companies rebuilding systems for artificial intelligence need exactly this kind of implementation work
watch: Large deal wins and revenue growth in constant currency.
